role: The /kill command: kills the sender with DamageSource.outOfWorld at Float.MAX_VALUE.
scope_reason: Not needed: /kill never runs in this game. Its level 0 is checked through EntityPlayerMP.canCommandSenderUseCommand (oracle/src/entity/player/EntityPlayerMP.java:1079), which for any command but seed, tell, help and me requires ServerConfigurationManager.func_152596_g (oracle/src/server/management/ServerConfigurationManager.java:683): an ops entry (none in a fresh singleplayer world), or singleplayer with WorldInfo.areCommandsAllowed (the oracle's world is new WorldSettings(seed, SURVIVAL, true, false, DEFAULT) without enableCommands, oracle/harness/netherite/oracle/Oracle.java:251, so allowCommands is false), or commandsAllowedForAll (set only by IntegratedServer.shareToLAN with cheats). CommandHandler.executeCommand therefore answers commands.generic.permission before processCommand. Typing it also needs C01PacketChatMessage and ServerCommandManager, both not_needed (lane/idxchat, 2026-09-27).
